headline: Seven kilometres easy after a successful rest day
summary: Garmin recorded 7h 50m sleep (score 83), sleeping heart rate 63 bpm, overnight HRV 52 ms, Body Battery 88 on waking, and Training Readiness 79. Yesterday’s prescribed full rest was followed. Run 7 km easy today at conversational effort, with no strides or faster work.

yesterday.summary: The preceding report prescribed full rest from running and cycling on 15 September. Garmin recorded no activity.
yesterday.prescribed: Full rest from running and cycling; optional 15–20 minutes of easy walking or gentle mobility only.

adherence_caveats: Garmin cannot verify unrecorded walking, mobility, symptoms, or perceived recovery.

recommendation.title: 7 km easy and conversational
details: Run exactly 7 km easy, targeting about 45–50 minutes at RPE 2–3/10 and a pace at which you can speak in full sentences.
Keep the entire run steady: no strides, hills, tempo sections, intervals, or make-up distance.
Sydney's city-level forecast is approximately 11–16°C and sunny today; this is general context, not a route-level measurement.
recommendation.alternative: If the warm-up feels unusually flat, replace the run with 25–35 minutes of easy walking or take complete rest.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Reduce to walking or stop for pain, illness, dizziness, altered gait, unusual fatigue, chest symptoms, or other concerning symptoms. Symptoms and medical advice override Garmin scores.

signals.interpretation: Recovery and current load support easy running, but not a second quality session two days after the tempo.

caveats: Garmin sleep, heart-rate, HRV, stress, Body Battery, readiness, and load measures are wearable-derived; use trends alongside how you feel.
Today's stress and Body Battery values are incomplete morning measures.
Sleeping-heart-rate baselines exclude the current night and use the prior seven and fourteen valid nights.
Today's temperature is a city-level forecast; no route-level humidity or dew-point estimate was available.
